<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining and output enable signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="ADD">Addition state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STORE">Store result state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width="2">Current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width="2">Next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="enable_reg" width="1">Register to hold the enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width="65">Register to store the result.</reg>
        <wire id="carry_out" width="1">Carry out signal from the last adder.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
                enable_reg <= 0;
                result_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                enable_reg <= i_en;
                if (current_state == STORE) begin
                    result_reg <= {carry_out, result};
                end
            end
        end

        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            next_state = current_state;
            case (current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (i_en) begin
                        next_state = ADD;
                    end
                end
                ADD: begin
                    next_state = STORE;
                end
                STORE: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end

        // Adder logic
        wire [63:0] sum;
        generate
            genvar i;
            for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) begin : adder_loop
                assign sum[i] = adda[i] + addb[i] + (i > 0 ? carry_out : 0);
                assign carry_out = (i > 0 ? carry_out : 0) | (adda[i] & addb[i]) | ((adda[i] ^ addb[i]) & carry_out);
            end
        endgenerate

        // Result assignment
        assign result = result_reg;
        assign o_en = (current_state == STORE && enable_reg);

        // Final carry out
        assign carry_out = (sum[63] & carry_out) | (sum[63] & sum[62]) | ((sum[63] ^ sum[62]) & carry_out);
    </implementation>
</module>
